summary.answer: AmmoWidgetWZContainer directly constructs this ability-item widget and overrides use-string labels/model afterward. Builds icon/glow, controller prompts, cycle prompt, hold-to-activate variants, LED and stack count. Prompt HiddenPreference delegates Warzone hide settings; Hidden checks killcam/play-of-match/team-spectator; the non-WZ KBM ability/ultimate/streak variants are explicitly AlwaysFalse, while KeyboardAndMouseAbilityWZ allows mouse/keyboard. Cycle Visible requires profile warzoneCycleItems=1 and quick inventory open, with Hidden AlwaysTrue fallback. Settings/storage/inventory/input notifications reevaluate those states. Stack text binds equipmentStackCount; Invisible when count<1. Self Hidden=count<1; InUse=state inuse; Deployed=AlwaysFalse; EmptyCharging=charging with powerRatio0; Charging=charging; PowerBased=not hidden. powerRatio/state/count updates reevaluate self. Through the named setState override, pulse only if ShouldPulseNewAmmo and current PowerBased; ammo link repeats that predicate, id link fades in only for cycle-items+quick inventory. PC alpha helper runs immediately and on powerRatio/hideRadiationHold. PreLoadFunc is called near the END, after close hook/subscriptions; IsPC hides the gamepad hold child. Return self. Frozen span contains no full class clips/close body outside it; preserve them as precise dependencies, not assumed implementation. Native event delivery, inventory production and settings remain external.
